transactions.desc: The Astros recalled King from Triple-A Sugar Land on Friday, Chandler Rome of The Athletic reports.
The Mariners recalled Taylor from Triple-A Tacoma on Friday.
The Pirates optioned Eisert to Triple-A Indianapolis on Friday, Danny Demilio of PittsburghBaseballNow.com reports.
The Pirates designated Bethancourt for assignment Friday, Danny Demilio of PittsburghBaseballNow.com reports.
The Reds optioned Johnson to Triple-A Louisville on Friday.
The Rockies claimed Harris off waivers from Atlanta on Friday.
The Giants claimed Kuhnel off waivers from the Brewers on Friday, Adam McCalvy of MLB.com reports.
The White Sox optioned Romo to Triple-A Charlotte on Friday.
The White Sox activated Teel (ankle) from the 10-day injured list Friday.
The Guardians designated Hernandez for assignment Friday, Tim Stebbins of MLB.com reports.
The Guardians recalled Peterson from Triple-A Columbus on Friday, Tim Stebbins of MLB.com reports.
The Guardians activated Cecconi (arm) from the 15-day injured list Friday, Tim Stebbins of MLB.com reports.
The Reds signed Fletcher to a minor-league contract Thursday.
The Mariners selected Fairchild's contract from Triple-A Tacoma on Thursday.
The Giants claimed Harris off waivers from the Red Sox on Thursday and optioned him to Triple-A Sacramento.
The Marlins recalled De Los Santos from Triple-A Jacksonville on Thursday.
The Marlins designated Jimenez for assignment Thursday.
The Mets claimed Weston off waivers from the Orioles on Thursday and optioned him to Triple-A Syracuse.
The Pirates recalled Curtis from Triple-A Indianapolis on Thursday.
The Pirates optioned Sisk to Triple-A Indianapolis on Thursday, Aiden Stepansky of MLB.com reports.
The Pirates recalled Dotel from Triple-A Indianapolis on Thursday, Aiden Stepansky of MLB.com reports.
The Dodgers reinstated Treinen (elbow) from the 60-day injured list Wednesday.
The Mariners signed Woods Richardson to a minor-league contract Wednesday and assigned him to Triple-A Tacoma.
The Brewers activated Kuhnel (shoulder) from the 15-day injured list Wednesday and designated him for assignment, Adam McCalvy of MLB.com reports.
The Mets optioned Ross to Triple-A Syracuse on Wednesday.
The Mets activated Hagenman (rib) from the 60-day injured list Wednesday.
The Royals designated Waters for assignment Wednesday.
The Royals activated Massey from the 7-day concussion injured list Wednesday.
The Rays optioned Cook to Triple-A Durham on Wednesday.
The Rays activated Jax (elbow) from the 15-day injured list Wednesday.
